info.name: Plerion API Documentation Alerts Vulnerabilities API

params.name: vulnerabilityIds
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on vulnerability ids. Accepts a comma-separated list with a maximum length of 100

params.name: assetIds
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on asset ids. Accepts a comma-separated list with a maximum length of 10

params.name: providers
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities based on provider. Accepts a comma-separated list of providers.

params.name: executionIds
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on execution ids. Accepts a comma-separated list with a maximum length of 10

params.name: integrationIds
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on integration ids. Accepts a comma-separated list with a maximum length of 10

params.name: assetGroupIds
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on asset group ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of asset group ids.

params.name: environmentIds
params.description:
Filter vulnerabilities on the environment. This parameter accepts any combination of environment name or environment IDs (UUIDs) in a comma-separated list.

**Supported environment names:**
- `production` - Production environment
- `non-production` - Non-production environment

params.name: packageName
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on a package name.

params.name: regions
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on asset regions.

params.name: targetName
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on a target name. For ECS Task Definitions this will be `{TaskDefinition}:{revision} > {containerImage}`

params.name: targetType
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on a target type.

params.name: targetClass
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on a target class.

params.name: hasKev
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on hasKev. Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: isExempted
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities based on exemptions. Returns exempted vulnerabilities if set true. Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: isExploitable
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities based on exploitability under the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS). Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: hasExploit
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on hasExploit. Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: hasVendorFix
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities where the affected packages have a fixed version. Is true if any affected package has a fixed version. Accepts `true` or `false`.

params.name: severityLevels
params.description: Filter vulnerabilities on severity. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: firstObservedAtStart
params.description:
Start of the date range for filtering vulnerabilities based on the first observed time.
Specify the start of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtStart` is provided and `firstObservedAtEnd` is omitted, 
results will include vulnerabilities observed from this date to the present.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: firstObservedAtEnd
params.description:
End of the date range for filtering vulnerabilities based on the first observed time.
Specify the end of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtEnd` is provided and `firstObservedAtStart` is omitted, 
results will include vulnerabilities observed up to this date.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort results by the specified field.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order for the results.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for the results. Accepts a positive integer.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of results per page. Accepts a positive integer.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Get the next batch of vulnerabilities. Used for pagination. When cursor is provided, the response will not include total count.

params.name: includeTotal
params.description: Include the total count of available vulnerabilities. Defaults to true. Set to false to improve response times for large datasets.

items.docs:
Use the list vulnerabilities API to filter vulnerabilities across the tenant with many options
from Organization, Tenant, Integration, Asset, Severity, etc. By default all vulnerabilities
are returned.

Date range filtering is supported using the `firstObservedAtStart` and `firstObservedAtEnd` parameters:
- `firstObservedAtStart` alone: Includes vulnerabilities observed from the specified date to the present.
- `firstObservedAtEnd` alone: Includes vulnerabilities observed up to the specified dat

info.name: List vulnerability exemptions in a profile

params.name: profileId
params.description: Profile ID (UUID) or the literal string "default" for the default profile.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of exemptions to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Get the next batch of exemptions.

items.docs: Lists all vulnerability exemptions scoped to the given profile with pagination support.

info.name: Create a vulnerability exemption in a profile

params.name: profileId
params.description: Profile ID (UUID) or the literal string "default" for the default profile.

items.docs: Creates an exemption definition scoped to the given profile. Use it to suppress specific vulnerabilities.

info.name: Get a vulnerability exemption by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Exemption ID (UUID)

params.name: profileId
params.description: Profile ID (UUID) or the literal string "default" for the default profile.

items.docs: Retrieves a specific vulnerability exemption by its ID.

info.name: Update a vulnerability exemption by ID

params.name: id

params.description: Profile ID (UUID) or the literal string "default" for the default profile.

items.docs: Updates a specific vulnerability exemption by its ID. All fields are optional for partial updates.

info.name: Delete a vulnerability exemption by ID

params.name: profileId
